OtherOwner.name: Other Owner
OtherOwner.definition: Other plan owner, used when PlanOwner is OtherNational or OtherPrivate.

NumberOfPeriods.name: Number Of Periods
NumberOfPeriods.definition: Number of period units between consecutive payments.

DeferredPeriods.name: Deferred Periods
DeferredPeriods.definition: Contains the number of period units between initiation of instalment plan and the date of required first payment.

FirstAmount.name: First Amount
FirstAmount.definition: Amount of the first payment when different from the subsequent payments.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency code associated with the instalment amount.  ISO 4217 "Codes for the representation of currencies and funds".

NumberOfGracePeriodUnits.name: Number Of Grace Period Units
NumberOfGracePeriodUnits.definition: Number of grace period as defined by grace period unit type.

CustomerSelectedGracePeriod.name: Customer Selected Grace Period
CustomerSelectedGracePeriod.definition: Indicates a customer selected grace period

AmountDetails.name: Amount Details
AmountDetails.definition: Contains the amount details of an instalment plan.

GrandTotalAmount.name: Grand Total Amount
GrandTotalAmount.definition: Total amount of the instalment including charges, insurance and taxes in addition to the funded amount.
